_readme: Copy to supabase/launch.json (gitignored), fill in, then:
pnpm launch supabase/launch.json           # dry run, writes nothing
owner_handle must already exist — sign in through the site once first.
subject_type: 'person' or 'thing'. closes_in_hours is optional (omit = no timer).
2-10 options per poll; people add more once it is live.
No votes are written. Get real ones from real friends before posting publicly.
